items.name: Shure SM7dB · complete XLR desk chain
items.why: Our premium broadcast/studio path: SM7dB with built-in active preamp, an XLR audio interface and a robust boom arm. This is a complete multi-part workflow, not a USB microphone.
items.best: A permanent interview, teaching and recording desk
pros: Deliberate close-mic placement on a boom arm
cons: 48V phantom power required for the active preamp
More cost and setup than USB
items.setup: Connect SM7dB by balanced XLR cable to an audio interface with 48V phantom power, then connect the interface to your computer by USB. Choose +18 or +28 dB built-in gain and set interface gain without clipping. Bypass works without phantom power, but removes the active gain. No external inline booster is needed for the active path. Mount securely 1–6 inches from your mouth; rehearse in the interview app.

items.best: Applicants whose current equipment already works

items.box: Use what you already own.

items.down: Do not buy a capture device or microphone arm to solve a camera-height problem.

items.box: Check the selected listing and package contents before ordering.

online.name: Background & room
online.intro: Choose an uncluttered, private space. A visible wall, a virtual background or a backdrop can all work after a rehearsal.

items.name: Use the soft furnishings you own
items.why: Curtains, a rug and nearby soft surfaces may reduce echo.
items.best: Applicants whose current equipment already works
items.setup: Record a short clip; compare before and after moving within the room.
items.box: Use what you already own.
items.up: A tidy real background with soft furnishings can reduce distractions and room reflections without buying a backdrop.
items.down: Start by removing distractions; extra styling does not improve interview answers.

items.name: Rehearse the interview platform background
items.why: If privacy requires a virtual background, test edges and motion.
items.best: Applicants whose current equipment already works
items.setup: Wear the actual outfit and check hands, hair and chair edges.
items.box: Use what you already own.
items.up: A rehearsed platform background offers privacy when the room cannot be changed. Test edge artifacts in your actual lighting.
items.down: A real tidy background is more predictable if software masking breaks around hair, glasses or hands.

items.name: A repeatable interview room
items.why: A dedicated space reduces day-of variables more than another purchase.
items.best: Applicants whose current equipment already works
items.setup: Mark your chair and light positions; arrange access to a quieter backup space.
items.box: Use what you already own.
items.up: A dedicated repeatable room removes last-minute variation in framing, noise and lighting. Reliability comes from rehearsal.
items.down: A shared room can work well with a quiet-time agreement and a tested backup location.

online.name: Power & connectivity
online.intro: A browser online signal is not a bandwidth or call-quality test. Rehearse the actual platform and a backup connection.

items.name: Anker PowerExpand A8313 USB-C to Gigabit Ethernet
items.why: A straightforward wired path when the router is reachable.
items.best: Laptops with a compatible USB-C data port
cons: Does not fix a weak ISP connection
items.setup: Add a tested Ethernet cable to your router. Keep Wi-Fi as fallback. Test the adapter on your OS and exact port.
items.box: Check the selected listing and package contents before ordering.
items.up: A compatible wired adapter removes Wi-Fi as the primary connection. Your router, ISP and computer still need reliable power.
items.down: Keep stable Wi-Fi if the actual platform rehearsal is reliable; an adapter cannot repair an ISP outage.

items.name: Rehearsed hotspot fallback
items.why: A tested second network is more useful than an untested battery purchase.
items.best: Applicants whose current equipment already works
items.setup: Check your data plan, reception and hotspot compatibility; practice reconnecting in your platform.
items.box: Use what you already own.
items.up: A tested cellular hotspot covers one class of home-network failure. Rehearse data limits, signal and the exact join flow.
items.down: Use the existing wired connection as primary; a hotspot is a fallback, not a speed or quality guarantee.

items.name: A second ready-to-join device
items.why: Continuity depends on the whole route: power, network, login and audio.
items.best: Applicants whose current equipment already works
items.setup: Prepare a charged second device with the right app. Follow program instructions for reconnecting.
items.box: Use what you already own.
items.up: A charged second device with the invite and coordinator contact covers a computer failure as well as a connection change.
items.down: A hotspot plus a working primary computer may be enough. Avoid buying another device purely for one interview.

online.name: Control & accessories
online.intro: Shortcuts are optional. Keep interview notes concise and avoid a teleprompter that makes your answers sound read.

items.box: Stream Deck Neo with integrated stand and fixed 90 cm USB-C cable. Stream Deck software is a free download; confirm current OS requirements and your computer port.
items.up: Eight visible keys cover a small set of tested actions. The USB-C connection and app compatibility must fit your computer.
items.down: Keyboard shortcuts cost nothing. Only add a control surface if it removes a problem you have rehearsed.

review.title: Stream Deck MK.2 · is it worth it?

items.box: Stream Deck MK.2, desktop stand, USB cable and quick-start guide. Elgato notes that cable packaging changed from USB-C/USB-A to USB-C/USB-C; confirm the selected seller’s pack and your computer port.
items.up: Fifteen visible keys give an ongoing teaching or recording workflow more dedicated actions than Neo. More keys do not improve interview answers.
items.down: Neo covers a small interview profile with less hardware. Keep a keyboard if it already works reliably.

review.title: Stream Deck + · dials, control and limitations

items.box: Stream Deck + controller with eight keys, four dials and touch strip. XLR Dock and USB Hub accessories are separate; confirm the selected package and USB connection.

items.down: MK.2 gives more dedicated keys; Neo or keyboard shortcuts simplify a small interview workflow.
